tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background for every screen. Warm, never pure white, so the app feels soft.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, inputs. Sits on cream; separate with shadow-soft, not borders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers inside cards only (1.25:1 on cream). Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls (3.5:1 on card, 3.3:1 on cream). Never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 11.4:1 on cream; passes on every pastel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders. Only on cream or card (5.5:1); fails on pastels, use ink there.

tokens.name: grape
tokens.usage: Brand pastel. Selected chips, highlight cards, welcome hero, special-care tag. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: grape-deep
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, focus rings. Text on it: card (8.1:1). The one strong color per screen.

tokens.name: grape-deep-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary buttons and links. Text on it: card.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Success: booking confirmed, payment done, everything fine. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Only the certified caregiver badge (the star) and real warnings. Yellow reads as caution: never for neutral content. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Info banners and chat bubbles from the caregiver. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Error and cancel surfaces. Pair with rose-deep text; never alone for meaning.

tokens.name: rose-deep
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive actions. 4.8:1 on rose, 6.4:1 on cream.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding and welcome.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ana cuidará a Luna el sábado de 9:00 a 13:00.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta info, timestamps, helper text. Minimum size in the app.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a title and its subtitle, and inside small stacks of text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between an avatar or icon and the text next to it, and between fields side by side.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen side gutter, gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of screen to title, around empty-state art.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tiles, images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets (top corners), banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets on cream. The only elevation; no hard borders.
